rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s

CITY OF GLENDALE
  COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN
  SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES
  February 27, 2019, 5:30 pm

1. ROLL CALL & WELCOME
  PRESENT:  Magran, Perian, Semerdjian, Dilanian, Garabetian
  ABSENT:  Broussalian, Burns
  STAFF:  Hayrapetian, Powers, Varpetian

A. Report regarding the posting of the Agenda: The Agenda for the February 27, 2019, special
meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside of City Hall on February 25, 2019.

2. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
A. Presentation: Laura Duncan, Executive Director, Ascencia
  Dr. Laura Duncan has been with Ascencia for five years, and was recently named
  Executive Director. She provided information about Ascencia, a homeless services
  agency located in South Glendale that serves men and women. Homeless crisis has
  become highly visible. She highlighted the factors that contribute to someone becoming
  homeless (i.e., mental health, substance abuse). Some of the services Ascencia
  provides include psychiatric services, trauma therapy, and tutoring for students. During
  2017-18, Ascencia served the highest number of people (1,291), compared to five years
  ago. She also highlighted the three phases of their services: (1) outreach, engagement,
  and assessment; (2) gathering documentation, accessing services, emergency shelter,
  establishing/increasing income; and (3) permanent housing and supportive services.
  Overall, Ascencia serves an average of 1200 people per year and has 45 beds that
  serve about 200 people per year. Dr. Duncan invited CSW members to tour Ascencia.

3. ORAL COMMENT: Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of this agenda. Each speaker
  is allowed 5 minutes. The Commission may question or respond to the speaker but there will
  be no debate or discussion. Staff may refer the matter to the proper department for
  investigation and report.

  No speaker cards were submitted

  Motion: Perian  Second: Semerdjian
  Roll call was conducted and Commissioners voted as follows:
  Ayes:  Magran, Perian, Semerdjian
  Noes:  --
  Abstain:  --

 6. COMMISSIONER/STAFF COMMENTS
  Commissioner Perian shared that she attended Soroptimist’s Human Trafficking

  Staff Powers mentioned that it was the inaugural DGA International Women’s Day

  receiving the Tom Miller Award from the Glendale Healthier Community Coalition on

  Commissioner Perian asked to get metrics for incarceration details and other vital (and
  readily available) data and Staff member Powers said she will reach out to the Glendale
  Police Department and the Verdugo Job Center for that data.

7. ADJOURNMENT
